packageRules.description: Everything (npm, GitHub Actions, pnpm itself, Medusa; patch, minor and major) goes into ONE weekly PR per repo, merged by hand. Lockfile refresh happens inside that PR, so separate lock file maintenance is off.
Medusa ships every @medusajs package in lockstep and the host app pins the same set. rangeStrategy bump rewrites the peer pin too, instead of widening it.
Hold TypeScript below 7: Medusa 2.23 builds through ts-node and the TypeScript compiler API, which TypeScript 7 (native Go compiler) no longer ships.
Hold pnpm below 12: pnpm 12 fails to install these repos in CI.
@types/node tracks the oldest Node in engines (>=22.22), so code cannot compile against APIs that runtime lacks.
Medusa stays on 2.23.x until a planned upgrade (@medusajs/ui is versioned separately).
Mark the weekly PR when it contains a major update, so it gets a closer review.
